mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_activity (tracking_number, booking_id, transport_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{transportStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tracking_activity SET transport_status = #{transportStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_handling_event (tracking_id, event_type, event_time, location_unlocode, voyage_number, consignee_confirmation, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{trackingId}, #{eventType}, #{eventTime}, #{locationUnlocode}, #{voyageNumber}, #{consigneeConfirmation}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tracking_id, event_type, event_time, location_unlocode, voyage_number, consignee_confirmation FROM tracking_handling_event WHERE tracking_id = #{trackingId} ORDER BY event_time ASC
